# `aitbc governance list`

List governance proposals with optional status, category, and proposer filters.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc governance list [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--status` | text | — | no | Filter by status (draft, active, succeeded, defeated, executed, cancelled) |
| `--category` | text | — | no | Filter by category |
| `--proposer-id` | text | — | no | Filter by proposer ID |
| `--format` | choice | — | no | Output format |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc governance list
```
